## Summary

Describe the small, scoped improvement.

## Suggested starter tasks

Pick one (or propose your own):

- [ ] Add unit test for an edge case in `internal/search` or `internal/crawl`
- [ ] Improve error classification keyword in `internal/observability/classify.go`
- [ ] Add an example script under `examples/` with a one-line description in `docs/use-cases.md`
- [ ] Document a flag or behavior in `docs/RULES.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] Change is focused (one concern)

## Notes

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a PR.
